headline: Materials research, from how a material behaves to what it can become.
intro: My work is grounded in experimental research across functional nanomaterials, thin films, interfaces and devices. I am interested in energy, sensing and semiconductor-related problems, and I am building computational skills to make future experiments more deliberate.
focusTitle: A few questions guide the work.
focusIntro: The rest belongs on the research and project pages. This is only the glimpse.

questions.title: How can materials do useful work?
questions.text: Functional materials, interfaces and device behaviour that connect material properties to something measurable and useful.

questions.title: Can experiments become more informed?
questions.text: Using theory, computation and eventually machine learning alongside the experimental judgement built through hands-on research.

questions.title: Can better materials solve real constraints?
questions.text: Energy, sensing and semiconductor-related problems considered with resource use, practicality and eventual application in mind.

contact.title: Have a defined research question or project?
contact.text: I am open to well-scoped research, scientific writing, literature synthesis, and data or visualisation work where my materials background can be useful.
